narrative.details:
It appears as if you've brought back more information than even I expected. This certainly is a strange turn of events, adventurer.

A cure? Hrm... Go down to the cellar and speak with Doc Mixilpixil - he may be able to help.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Doc Mixilpixil in the cellar of the Barracks.
narrative.offerRewardText: It's about time! Just put the cheese on the table and skedaddle. Osborne will pay you on the way out.
